prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE NEW finished webcomic panel, not a poster, collage, split board or multiple panels. SQUARE image, requested 1024x1024.
Reference 1 is the original drawing/world benchmark. Reference 2 supplies only our newly inspected cast identities, clothing and equipment. Compose the completely new moment described below. Do not reproduce either reference's framing or add its absent characters.

Drawing treatment: Thin controlled anime contours, elegant facial planes, angular dark hair, tailored pale jacket against black clothing; luminous glass translucency against layered inhabited navy architecture. Preserve The integrated invitation of face, creature, city and night atmosphere; inhabited balconies and quiet cyan windows. Avoid Bodybuilder armor, uniform low-angle full-body shots, wet reflective pavement, citywide speckle and a ray inserted behind every close-up.
World context: Layered vertical city at blue night. Upper admission gate on RIGHT, maintenance lift below LEFT side of same bridge, thick black metal anchor posts. Warm human windows, distant hanging gardens.
VISIBLE subjects in this panel ONLY:
Aren Vale: Light-skinned adult man, slim athletic build, narrow appealing face, gray eyes, swept midnight hair. Tailored ivory waist-length jacket WITH long sleeves over fitted black high-neck top, black slim trousers, plain boots and one red courier cord. Closer to original full Nightglass elegance; distinct provisional adaptation, not automatic original cast selection. Equipment: One solid silver crescent-edge short sword with black straight hilt and cyan pommel ring, anatomically RIGHT-handed when drawn. One flat sealed cream dispatch wallet. Do not assume either is in his hand or on his belt: the exact current inventory below controls position and possession.
Inspected reference qualification for visible subjects only: none
Visibility/cropping constraints: Only the subjects above, framed as specified below.
ONE current moment: Aren crouches at the bridge edge and attaches his pommel line to the heavy post behind his right shoulder.
Current physical state (authoritative): One taut line from right sword pommel to visible post; both boots braced on bridge; lift below out of frame.
Special visual element, only if specified: none
Camera and framing: Low medium side, complete boots and both line endpoints. Respect actual subject-to-frame size, especially extreme wides. Do not enlarge a distant person into a medium shot.
Reserve the upper 35% of the image as calm, broad in-world background for later speech balloons. Keep ALL faces, hands, important contact and clue details BELOW that zone. Do not draw balloons or text; the blank space will receive editable lettering.
Draw acting with a specific expression and body intention. For contact, show the physical source/contact/target and its immediate reaction. For a clasp or weapon, make shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand-object ownership legible. Keep supports, scale and visible limb anatomy sound. Do not add later injuries, additional duplicates, alternate weapons, generic glows or undescribed consequences.
Surface design: matte quiet ground, broad deliberate light and shadow shapes, selective purposeful architecture. Group foliage, hair and material marks. Keep medium-defining directional ink/brushwork; avoid pervasive microtexture, repeated tiny facets, flooring crack networks, mirror floors and reflection glitter. Preserve richness through faces, composition and world depth.
No text of any kind, no speech balloons, no glyphs, no captions, no SFX lettering, no UI, no signatures, no watermark, no frame. Exact dialogue will be added separately. Return only the new artwork.
INVENTORY CONTINUITY — This is state information, not a request to add people. Only Aren Vale may appear physically, with the stated crop. Keep Sera Voss, Pell, Glass ray physically OUTSIDE this frame even if named in possession history. The existing action, camera and explicit nonphysical special elements control what is visible.
Aren sword is the ONE drawn sword in anatomical RIGHT hand. LEFT hand is the rescue/free hand; never mirror these roles. The cream dispatch wallet is with Sera, stowed in her coat pocket outside action crops. Aren has NO cream wallet, envelope or white dispatch case on belt or in either hand. Jacket fully intact, no tears. One taut cyan tether runs from the cyan POMMEL RING BEHIND the right sword grip to the SAME heavy bridge post above/right. It never joins blade tip, blade edge, hip, clothing or Pell. Crop an endpoint only where the assigned close framing explicitly requires it. Pell wears body harness; a separate safety tether remains clipped to lift rail. The maintenance car remains attached to its suspension cable.
COMPOSITION FOR EDITABLE DIALOGUE: Do not change action geometry merely to fit speaker order; identify each balloon after actual art using short attribution and deliberate tail routing. Offscreen voices stay offscreen.
FINAL SHOT PRIORITY: Low medium side, complete boots and both line endpoints. Depict only this instant: Aren crouches at the bridge edge and attaches his pommel line to the heavy post behind his right shoulder. No added text or panel division.
